name: aside
description: A prompt queue for Claude Code. Queue prompts, ideas and comments while Claude works, without interrupting it, and send them once it finishes or whenever you are ready.

afterClaudeAnswers.title: After Claude answers
afterClaudeAnswers.description: What aside does by itself when Claude finishes answering and something is queued. wait: nothing, you run /aside. plan: what /aside plan does. run all: what /aside run all does, each entry a step of its own.

planModel.title: Model for /aside plan
planModel.description: session: Claude plans in this conversation, knowing the work so far, on the session's model. sonnet, haiku, opus: one call to that model plans outside the conversation; it adds nothing to the context and runs while Claude works, but sees only the queue.

newQueues.title: New named queues
newQueues.description: Whom a named queue made by its first idea, as in +@work, is for. global: every project sees it. local: only the project it was made in. /aside q NAME local or global changes one later.

order.title: Which entry comes first
order.description: oldest: first in, first out. newest: last in, first out. /aside lists, numbers and runs the queue in this order.

tidy.title: Tidy what you type
tidy.description: on: a small model fixes the spelling, punctuation and wording of each entry's own text, in its language, once it is queued. The copied quote is never changed or sent. off: entries stay as typed.
